notes.title: Nominate Us at Steam Awards!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43694095/b8114fdd670a287ff46ad276ec6b60b8154b7c04.jpg

Dear players,

The Steam Awards are here and we need your help! We need you to nominate Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong in the Best Soundtrack category!

Every voice counts, and what better way than for the community to reward the work of Olivier Derivière, the composer of the VTMS Original Soundtrack. 

Thank you for your support!
The Vampire: The Masquerade team - Swansong

Available Now On Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299510/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Swansong/
